_about: Item encyclopedia data (Sal, 2026-10-31), generated from items.json, gathered.json, recipes.json, drops.json, carcass.json, blueprints.json, flora.json and item_uses.json by an ad hoc script; read by nothing yet. Descriptions are the existing one-line item descriptions (validate_items checks their length and full stop); `how_to_get` lists recipes and the places the data says it drops, `used_for` lists recipes and blueprints that spend it. `status: planned` means the item is flagged future (not obtainable in the game yet). Placed structures are not listed. Hand edits so far: item_uses.json lines were audited for truth.
